version.description: Semantic version of the token schema

issuer.description: Public key or stable node ID of the granting entity

recipient.description: Public key or stable node ID of the authorised recipient

purpose.description: Human and machine-readable description of the authorised action

shard_class.description: Class of shards this token covers

max_bytes.description: Maximum bytes permitted for transfer (0 = unlimited)

issued_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of token issuance

expires_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when token becomes invalid (hard wall-clock expiry)

revocable.description: All tokens must be revocable (always true in v0.1)

revocation_endpoint.description: Optional local or network path where revocation status can be checked

one_time_use.description: Token becomes invalid after first use

signature.description: Ed25519 cryptographic signature over canonical token serialization (excluding this field)

design_rules: No ambient authority — token grants permission only between named issuer and recipient
Purpose binding — purpose field is mandatory and human-readable
Time binding — every token has hard expires_at
Instant revocation — revocation takes effect as soon as known
Minimal size — tokens must remain small for constrained devices
No silent renewal — extension requires new token with new signature
Offline verifiable — verification must be possible using only issuer public key and local clock
lifecycle: CREATED — issuer constructs and signs token
TRANSMITTED — token travels with or ahead of shard via Noise IK helix
VERIFIED — recipient checks signature, expiry, scope, revocation status
ACTIVE — token is valid and in use
INVALID — token fails any verification check

revocation_mechanism.description: Revocation is a signed message containing token_id and revocation timestamp
revocation_mechanism.propagation: No central revocation list; revocation propagates through consented channels
node_behaviour: Periodically check while helix is open
Cache active tokens and recent revocations
Once seen, token is permanently invalid on that node

reference_notes.cryptography: Ed25519 preferred; must support Noise IK binding
reference_notes.serialisation: Canonical JSON (deterministic field order, no whitespace) for signing
reference_notes.encoding_for_wire: Prefer CBOR for constrained nodes; keep signed payload under 500 bytes
reference_notes.tier_0_constraints: Minimal Noise IK implementation required; offline verification essential
